competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times. Each attack has a 25% chance to increase the enemy's chance of dealing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on an ally target and fills up the ally's Attack Bar. If the target has no harmful effects to remove, grants Recovery for 1 turn.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
The target's HP will be recovered by 15% on each turn.

competences.description: Grants immunity on all allies for 2 turns with holy powers. In addition, the target ally will become invincible for 2 turns, and all other allies will be granted with a shield that's proportionate to your level for 2 turns.

effets.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
The target will be invincible and receive no damage.
The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
